The moving average: a low-pass you can do in your head

Set how many samples to average and pick a tone. See the response, its nulls at multiples of 1/L, and the tone coming out smaller by exactly that much.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/fpga/dsp/signals.t27 (t27#8985): every value on the page is its fn bodies, compiled to wasm (logic.js)
  • R. G. Lyons, Understanding Digital Signal Processing, 3rd ed., ch. 5: finite impulse response filters
  • S. W. Smith, The Scientist and Engineer's Guide to Digital Signal Processing, ch. 15: moving average filters
